missing: blank means unknown/not-sampled, never invented zero
units: canonical joint deg, wheel rad/s, world m and m/s; body rad and rad/s
trace_scope: tick0, every8 physics ticks and true terminal; full-rate extrema remain in each summary

clock_contract.sequence_source_definition: command_time_s=pre-step tick/120; native B/C rows are post-step, A commands are pre-step
clock_contract.sequence_export_definition: command_pre_step_time_s explicitly renames legacy command_time_s; pre-step tick t precedes the effect in post-step physical tick t+1, at 120Hz.
clock_contract.trace_definition: episode_physics_tick and simulation_time_s are measured post-step coordinates (except true reset tick0); native_internal_tick is a different reset-offset clock and is never substituted.
clock_contract.owner_definition: Owner observation_tick and decision_end_tick remain separately recorded inside JSON cells; neither is silently aligned to current trace measurement.
clock_contract.response_definition: available_response_sample_tick is a retained measurement, not an exact response onset; measured_response_tick can be null or a separately labeled evaluator event.
sequence_source_limits: Sparse response samples are not exact onset or causal attribution
Missing measurement remains null; contact_surface TOP is not necessarily top_contact/placement
A historical latch/guard semantics remain labeled; no historical posture gate imported
No full trajectory copying or new simulation; JSON rows for separate spreadsheet author

attribution: final minus mapper N before geometry is a total difference that can include nominal geometry, controller bias, slew and shared history; N is this run's actual unique mapper output, not an independent fresh FSM trajectory. Use explicit RR decomposition and exact same-prestate policy deltas. Native wheel signs are canonical times [-1,+1,-1,+1].
